snippets.body: MethaneSAT's data provides insights that can help reduce methane emissions from the oil and gas industry
snippets.attribution: MethaneSAT · Our Mission Page — https://www.methanesat.org/mission

snippets.body: Small, widespread sources account for at least 70% of methane emissions from oil and gas production. MethaneSAT sees what others don't and provides the high-resolution data necessary to measure whether action is taken.
snippets.attribution: MethaneSAT · Solving a crucial climate challenge — https://www.methanesat.org/

snippets.body: MethaneSAT data provides energy producers, government agencies and other users access to insights to help identify the greatest opportunities for reducing methane emissions.
snippets.attribution: MethaneSAT · Our Mission Page — https://www.methanesat.org/mission

snippets.body: While operational, MethaneSAT monitored areas that produce 80% or more of the world's oil and gas. It measured emissions across very large areas in a matter of seconds and saw changes in concentrations as small as 3 parts per billion.
snippets.attribution: MethaneSAT · Our Mission Page — https://www.methanesat.org/mission

snippets.body: Data from MethaneSAT will be freely available to anyone with an internet connection, making it possible to see where emissions are coming from with unparalleled precision, making it easier for both operators and regulators to find and fix problems faster

snippets.body: MethaneSAT was conceived and developed by the non-profit Environmental Defense Fund, a global leader in methane science, policy and emissions reduction.
snippets.attribution: MethaneSAT · Solving a crucial climate challenge — https://www.methanesat.org/

snippets.body: MethaneSAT was made possible entirely by the support of EDF donors and our partnership with the Government of New Zealand . Among the largest contributors to MethaneSAT are the Bezos Earth Fund, Arnold Ventures, the Robertson Foundation and the TED Audacious Project.
snippets.attribution: MethaneSAT · IN ORBIT: Successful MethaneSAT launch represents groundbreaking mission to protect the climate — https://www.methanesat.org/project-updates/orbit-successful-methanesat-launch-represents-groundbreaking-mission-protect

snippets.body: The Bezos Earth Fund announced Tuesday at a White House Summit on "super-pollutant" greenhouse gas emissions that it will provide $10 million in new funding to Environmental Defense Fund (EDF) to support MethaneSAT, a groundbreaking satellite that will locate, measure and track methane emissions around the world.
snippets.attribution: MethaneSAT · Bezos Earth Fund announces $10 million in new funding for MethaneSAT — https://www.methanesat.org/project-updates/bezos-earth-fund-announces-10-million-new-funding-methanesat

snippets.body: In addition to parent organization EDF, MethaneSAT partners include Harvard University's School of Engineering and Applied Sciences, the Smithsonian Astrophysical Observatory, and the New Zealand Space Agency. The combined mission team has over 70 experts worldwide with experience in spaceflight, remote sensing, and data analytics. The satellite was built in Colorado by the Space & Mission Systems unit of BAE Systems, Inc. (formerly Ball Aerospace) and Blue Canyon Technologies.
snippets.attribution: MethaneSAT · IN ORBIT: Successful MethaneSAT launch represents groundbreaking mission to protect the climate — https://www.methanesat.org/project-updates/orbit-successful-methanesat-launch-represents-groundbreaking-mission-protect

snippets.body: MethaneSAT's superpower is the ability to precisely measure methane levels with high resolution over wide areas, including smaller, diffuse sources that account for most emissions in many regions
snippets.attribution: MethaneSAT · IN ORBIT: Successful MethaneSAT launch represents groundbreaking mission to protect the climate (Steven Hamburg, EDF Chief Scientist and MethaneSAT project leader) — https://www.methanesat.org/project-updates/orbit-successful-methanesat-launch-represents-groundbreaking-mission-protect

snippets.body: On Friday, June 20, the MethaneSAT mission operations lost contact with MethaneSAT. After pursuing all options to restore communications, we learned this morning that the satellite has lost power, and that it is likely not recoverable.

snippets.body: We also will continue to work closely with our partners to reduce methane emissions and implement the goals of the Global Methane Pledge, The Oil and Gas Decarbonization Charter, Oil and Gas Methane Partnership 2.0, the United Nations Environment Programme's International Emissions Observatory and Climate and Clean Air Coalition
snippets.attribution: MethaneSAT · MethaneSAT loses contact with satellite — https://www.methanesat.org/project-updates/methanesat-loses-contact-satellite

snippets.body: The Oil & Gas Methane Partnership 2.0 (OGMP 2.0) is the flagship oil and gas reporting and mitigation programme of the United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP). It is the only comprehensive, measurement-based international reporting framework for the sector.

snippets.body: Methane is a potent, fast-acting greenhouse gas that's rapidly accelerating the rise in global temperatures. Countries and companies across the world have made reducing emissions an urgent priority.
snippets.attribution: MethaneSAT · Our Mission Page — https://www.methanesat.org/mission

snippets.body: Methane is a potent greenhouse gas that has more than 80 times the warming power of carbon dioxide over the first 20 years after it reaches the atmosphere.

snippets.body: At Maimonides Health, our purpose is to serve you. Your well-being is at the heart of everything we do. snippets.body: The Center for Family Support is committed to providing support and assistance to individuals with developmental and related disabilities, and to the family members who care for them.
snippets.attribution: Center for Family Support · Mission and Vision — https://www.cfsny.org/about-cfs/mission-and-vision/

snippets.body: To achieve our mission, we strive to: Support individuals to live the lives they want Respect different backgrounds, individual choice and overall family needs Provide families with the support they need at all stages of life Involve individuals in their communities Deliver excellent, individualized support to all
snippets.attribution: Center for Family Support · Mission and Vision — https://www.cfsny.org/about-cfs/mission-and-vision/

snippets.body: The Center for Family Support is recognized as effective in helping people with developmental and related disabilities achieve self-determination. We have a reputation for trust, caring and excellence among individuals and families, regulators, colleague agencies, and general public.
snippets.attribution: Center for Family Support · Mission and Vision — https://www.cfsny.org/about-cfs/mission-and-vision/

snippets.body: Community Habilitation provides one-to-one training to people with intellectual/developmental disabilities to develop or enhance the skills needed to live more independently in their homes or in the community.
snippets.attribution: Center for Family Support · New York Programs and Services — https://www.cfsny.org/supports-services/new-york/

snippets.body: Today, CFS staff provide assistance and support to about 1,000 individuals with developmental disabilities of all ages in their home and communities across New York and New Jersey.
snippets.attribution: Center for Family Support · Mission and Vision — https://www.cfsny.org/about-cfs/mission-and-vision/

snippets.body: We support 169 people throughout New York City's five boroughs and Westchester County in various settings. Depending on wants and needs, individuals might live on their own with staff coming in a few hours a day (supportive housing); live independently with help getting set up and managing household bills (individual support services); or they might need 24-hour support, where they live in small homes with others or in their own apartment (supervised IRAs).
snippets.attribution: Center for Family Support · New York Programs and Services — https://www.cfsny.org/supports-services/new-york/

snippets.body: In 1954 a small group of parents founded The Center for Family Support to meet the special needs of individuals with developmental disabilities and their families. The original intention of the organization was to provide respite services to individuals in order to maintain their loved ones at home.
snippets.attribution: Center for Family Support · Mission and Vision — https://www.cfsny.org/about-cfs/mission-and-vision/
